description: Triple-rail power supply with a single-rail power-good monitor. TPS54331 converts 12V to 5V, AMS1117-3.3 converts 5V to 3.3V, ME6211 converts 3.3V to 1.8V. One LM393 comparator channel monitors the 3.3V rail and generates POWER_GOOD. The unused comparator channel inputs are tied to ground. Focus is multi-stage power distribution plus one minimal power-good monitor.

verification_assertions.desc: GND unification: all ground pins across the power ICs and comparator share one common ground net.
3.3V rail: AMS1117 output feeds ME6211 input and ME6211 CE for auto-enable.
LM393 used monitor input observes the 3.3V rail directly.
Unused LM393 comparator channel inputs are tied to ground.
Critical domain isolation: 12V input, switch node, 5V rail, 3.3V rail, 1.8V rail, GND, feedback midpoint, and LM393 threshold input must be distinct where required.
The used LM393 comparator inputs must not be tied to the same net.
Unified ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
12V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V rail must carry Power attribute.
1.8V rail must carry Power attribute.
LM393 supply must connect to a valid power rail.
TPS54331 EN must not be left floating; requires a defined enable state.
LM393 used comparator threshold/reference input must not float.
TPS54331 feedback divider on VSENSE sets the 5V output voltage.
TPS54331 switch node PH must reach the 5V output rail through an inductor.
TPS54331 switch node must have a freewheeling diode path.
LM393 used threshold/reference input should have a simple resistor divider or bias path to ground.
LM393 threshold/reference input should be sourced from the 3.3V rail through resistor(s), allowing a simple threshold divider.
LM393 POWER_GOOD open-drain output requires a pull-up resistor to a real power rail.
12V input rail must have bypass capacitor to ground.
5V rail must have output/decoupling capacitor to ground.
3.3V rail must have output/decoupling capacitor to ground.
1.8V rail must have output capacitor to ground.
